exposure: Women with BMI loss more than 2 kg/m(2)
interpregnancy body mass index (BMI, kg/m(2)) change
Women with BMI gain more than 2 kg/m(2)
cohort: Multiparous women without a history of Cesarean delivery
finding: Compared with interpregnancy BMI change ± 2 kg/m(2), interpregnancy BMI gain 2 kg/m(2) was associated with increased odds of intrapartum Cesarean delivery.
mod_finding: Interpregnancy BMI gain of more than 2 kg/m(2) was associated with increased odds of intrapartum Cesarean delivery and Cesarean delivery for arrest disorders.
